research_question: Owner-approved addition: Best Registered Agent Services: National Providers Compared. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for registered agent services, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Small-business owners, founders, and consumers in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; Harbor Compliance renewal corrected from $149 to $159, changing its three-year total from $397 to $417; Rocket Lawyer agent price corrected from $124.99 to $125 and its $249 and $349 membership prices cut (Rocket Lawyer blocks automated readers); Bizee renewal source changed to its registered agent page.
